name: Semaglutide
mechanism: GLP-1 analogue with potent glycaemic and weight loss effects
dosing: Subcutaneous or oral formulations per product; titration required
contraindications: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or MEN2; hypersensitivity to product components
interactions: May delay gastric emptying and thus delay absorption of oral medicines; consider timing for oral drugs with narrow therapeutic indices
monitoring: Monitor glycaemic control, weight, GI side effects during dose titration; consider pancreatic symptoms and refer if severe abdominal pain
pregnancy: Avoid use in pregnancy; discuss alternatives and specialist review if pregnancy planned or confirmed
sideEffects: Common: nausea, vomiting, early satiety; rare but serious: pancreatitis; may cause weight loss which is often intended
clinicalPearls: Requires gradual dose titration to minimise GI adverse effects; effective for glycaemic control and weight reduction in eligible patients; counsel on injection technique (if SC)
indication: Type 2 diabetes for glycaemic control and, in selected patients, for weight management under specialist pathways
